PIO Best Newcomer Named
They say first impressions are lasting impressions. If this is true, Pioneer League hitters had better be wary -- <Brandyn Sittinger:player#23282> could be around for years to come. The <Modesto:team#356> starter took home the 2026 PIO Rookie of the Year Award today.

<Sittinger:player#23282> fashioned a 12-1 mark in 20 starts. He threw 117 innings, collected 118 strikeouts and put up a 4.54 ERA.

He received 10 first place votes out of a possible 14. <Frankie Bartow:player#27248> of the <Rocky Mountain Vibes:team#314> finished second in voting, while <Damiano Palmegiani:player#27338> of the <Modesto Roadsters:team#356> finished third with 3 first place votes.
